issues.quote: Faint, and quick, and from the top of the house. That is all I have to say of them.
issues.fact: B4 says only that the faint quick bells came from the master's window up above. It does not say the window is on the top floor of the house.
issues.misreading: A solver could read this as placing the master's window at the top of the house, the same floor as the atelier where Monnier was found. That would tie the bells to the atelier's location, which the fact sheet does not establish.
